title: 肺腺癌多重成像中的肿瘤—免疫—基质空间组织探索

source.name: MCMICRO exemplar-001
source.description: A public three-cycle, 12-channel CyCIF lung adenocarcinoma specimen distributed as the minimal end-to-end MCMICRO exemplar.

analysis.question: 肺腺癌小组织芯中，上皮、免疫和基质成分是否形成稳定且可解释的空间邻域？
analysis.blind_policy: The Agent receives tissue identity, channel metadata and file provenance but no expected cell fractions, spatial neighborhoods, thresholds, or paper conclusions.
